annotations.title: TIA — local sessions of a server project

description: Lists the local sessions that exist for one server project on the serve host, created by the Windows user of the serve, as {server, project, sessions:[{sessionId, projectFile}], total}; projectFile is the session file (.alsNN) or null. Pass projectFile to tia_local_session_open. `project` is the project name from tia_server_projects (exact name first, then ignoring case). An unknown name is 404 not_found (details.available lists the names that work), a name that matches several is 409 ambiguous_name (details.matches), and a Project Server that is unreachable or refuses the Windows user of the serve is 502 project_server_error (details.server, operation, type, message). Needs a running TIA Portal on the serve host (tia_start) but no open project. Maps to GET /multiuser/servers/{server}/projects/{project}/sessions. Read-only (class R).
name: tia_server_project_sessions
title: TIA — local sessions of a server project
